# For Player Variable

Source: [wiki article 4384](../archive/4384.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [For Player Variable](../../api/actions/for-player-variable.md).

<a id="wiki-4384-n1"></a>

- For Player Variable uses only the first player when multiple players are supplied.

<a id="wiki-4384-n2"></a>

- Stop bound is exclusive and checked before the first iteration; Step sign determines pass direction and is applied at End.
